title: Saudi Arabian Delicate Chicken and Rice
description: A flavorful Saudi Arabian dish made with tender chicken, fluffy rice, and a hint of spices. Serve with a side of fresh vegetables.

ingredients.name: delicate saudi spices
ingredients.notes: mix of cumin, coriander, and turmeric

ingredients.name: arabian seeds (like cumin seeds or nigella seeds)

instructions: Rinse the chicken breast and pat dry with paper towels.
Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken breast and cook until browned on both sides, about 5-6 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add 2 tablespoons of oil to the skillet and sauté the saudi spices for 1 minute.
Add the long grain rice to the skillet and stir to coat with the spice mixture.
Add the bowl of water to the skillet and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the skillet, and simmer for 18-20 minutes or until the rice is cooked.
Fluff the cooked rice with a fork and stir in the arabian seeds (if using).
Serve the chicken breast on top of the rice and garnish with fresh vegetables.
